subject: Post-call: Model fit & multilingual evals (EU/APAC)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Anna Leclerc <anna.leclerc@globex.com>, Hiroshi Takahashi <hiro.takahashi@novanet.jp>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 13:15:00 -0500
Subject: Post-call: Model fit & multilingual evals (EU/APAC)

Hi Anna & Hiroshi —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call + proposed next steps focused on multilingual quality checks across EU and APAC locales: 

What we heard
- Primary use cases: customer support triage (FR/ES), localized FAQ generation (FR/ES), and short-form knowledge extraction for JP.
- Success metrics: intent-classification F1 and generation adequacy (human eval) per locale; latency <= 300ms p50 for routed inference.
- Constraints: EU data residency for French/Spanish content; some low-resource dialects in APAC.

Recommended near-term plan
1) Run a paired eval (500 examples per locale) using our eval harness to measure accuracy/quality across candidate models.
2) Provide per-locale prompt set and baseline prompt engineering (attached).
3) Recommend model variants for pilot and a fallback strategy for low-resource languages.

Initial model recommendations (based on today’s convo and our benchmark):
- redwood-xlarge-multilingual-v2 (preferred for FR/ES; best latency/quality tradeoff)
- open-7b-multilang-q8 (cost-effective baseline; watch for hallucination on long FR prompts)
- redwood-7b-asia-optim (recommended for JP tokenization and efficiency)

I attached: redwood_eval_report_globex_20261113.pdf (summary), prompt_sets_fr_es_ja_v1.csv (sample prompts), and locale_benchmark_scores_20261113.xlsx (raw scores). Also linking the HubSpot deal and our eval scoreboard.

Can we confirm:
- Approval to run the 500x-per-locale eval (we’ll need a sample dataset or 0.5–1k test prompts from your side), and
- Target pilot start date (we suggested week of Nov 22).

Next steps: if you confirm the eval, Vivek will run a quick pre-flight and share the initial scoreboard within 3 business days. We’ll include region-aware hosting notes for EU residency.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0134

Attachments: redwood_eval_report_globex_20261113.pdf; prompt_sets_fr_es_ja_v1.csv; locale_benchmark_scores_20261113.xlsx

From: Anna Leclerc <anna.leclerc@globex.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Hiroshi Takahashi <hiro.takahashi@novanet.jp>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 16:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Post-call: Model fit & multilingual evals (EU/APAC)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Data residency: For the FR/ES evals we need the test data and results stored in an EU region (ideally Frankfurt). Can you confirm that the eval harness and storage will respect EU residency?
2) Sample dataset: We can share ~600 support tickets (anonymized) for FR and ~400 for ES; for JP we have 300 short dialogs. Is that sampling okay?
3) Pilot budget: Can you provide a rough cost estimate for the pilot (models you listed + eval CPU/GPU run time)?

Also, on fallback strategy — for some of our APAC markets we may prefer a smaller JA-optimized model rather than the multilingual generalist. Is that something you can include in the recommendation?

Appreciate it — happy to confirm the eval once we get your residency confirmation and cost estimate.

Best,
Anna
Senior Product Manager, Globex
anna.leclerc@globex.com
+33 1 23 45 67 89

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Anna Leclerc <anna.leclerc@globex.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Model fit & multilingual evals (EU/APAC)

Hi Anna —

Quick answers to your items and some technical detail: 

1) EU residency: Confirmed — we can run the eval harness and store results in our eu-west-1 (Frankfurt) tenant. We’ll provision a temporary bucket with strict region ACLs and provide you the access controls.

2) Sample sizes: 600 FR / 400 ES / 300 JP are fine. For statistical confidence we recommend at least 500 per locale; if you can add a small holdout (50) per locale that helps for blind eval.

3) Pilot cost estimate (rough) — covering eval runs + short pilot (2 weeks):
- redwood-xlarge-multilingual-v2: $3,200
- open-7b-multilang-q8: $1,100
- redwood-7b-asia-optim: $1,800
- Eval harness + storage (EU-hosted): $400
Estimated total: ~$6.5k (subject to final dataset size and runtime).

Model behavior notes (from our bench):
- FR/ES: xlarge-multilingual-v2 shows +12% relative improvement on adequacy vs open-7b in our FR/ES in-domain prompts, with comparable p50 latency. Watch for length truncation on very long FR threads — we recommended a prompt chunking rule in the attached CSV.
- JP: redwood-7b-asia-optim handles morphological tokenization better and produces fewer segmentation errors on short dialogs; however, it underperforms on rare dialect tokens — fallback to the multilingual-v2 for out-of-distribution queries might reduce failure rates.

Next steps I can run:
- Pre-flight eval (sanity run) using a 50-sample per-locale seed you provide — 24–48h turnaround.
- Full 500-sample runs (approx 2–3 hr per model per locale on our reserved cluster).

If you’re good, share the anonymized files to the Drive link I’ll send via DM, and I’ll kick off the pre-flight.

Thanks,
Vivek
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com

From: Anna Leclerc <anna.leclerc@globex.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 14:47:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Post-call: Model fit & multilingual evals (EU/APAC)

Vivek —

That all sounds reasonable. We’ll:
- Upload anonymized datasets to the Drive folder you mentioned (labelled: GLOBEX_eval_inputs_20261116).
- Confirm holdout splits (we’ll include 50 per locale).

Two requests before you run anything: 
1) Please include per-locale prompt templates (we need clarified examples for FR formal vs FR informal tone). I saw a couple in the CSV but would like a short doc with do/don'ts.
2) For cost, please also include an estimate for a 4-week pilot at low throughput (1 qps sustained) so procurement can pre-approve budget.

If you can provide both items by EOD Wednesday (Nov 18 CET), we’ll greenlight the pre-flight.

Best,
Anna

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Anna Leclerc <anna.leclerc@globex.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 16:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call: Model fit & multilingual evals (EU/APAC)

Thanks Anna — appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming next steps and timeline: 

1) Vivek will produce the per-locale prompt doc + do/don'ts (FR formal/informal) and the 4-week low-throughput cost estimate by EOD Nov 18 CET.
2) Globex uploads anonymized inputs to the Drive folder (GLOBEX_eval_inputs_20261116). Once uploaded, Vivek will execute the 50-sample pre-flight within 24–48h.
3) After pre-flight, we’ll share the full scoreboard and recommend the pilot model and fallback policy.

I’ve added the HubSpot deal link and the eval report to the attachments for your procurement team. If anything else is needed to move this to procurement (SOW, PO template), I can loop in our finance lead.

Looking forward — I’ll mark week of Nov 22 as tentative pilot start in HubSpot pending the pre-flight success.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
